hypothesis_assessments.statement: remaining_after_purchase reached zero when requested quantity equals remaining stock, causing a division by zero

additional_facts: Commit 91166e4651cff306a7cd351b8f05048a6fe7b21b introduced the zero-denominator clearance calculation approximately 7 hours 35 minutes before the reported first occurrence.
The exception occurs before inventory is decremented, so identical requests can reproduce the failure without consuming stock.
A direct invocation of calculate_total(24.99, 5, 5) reproduced ZeroDivisionError: float division by zero.
The repository already contains a strict xfail test expressing that buying exactly the remaining stock should succeed.
validated_root_cause: The non-bulk pricing branch divides CLEARANCE_DISCOUNT_RATE by remaining_stock minus quantity without handling zero, while checkout explicitly permits quantity to equal available stock.
planning_path_reason: The defect is localized to checkout pricing and fixing it restores existing documented checkout behavior without changing a specified requirement or requiring multiple components.
undetermined: The raw telemetry reference sample-raw-ref-1 was unavailable, so the reported two production occurrences could not be independently verified.
The Incident Package does not identify the deployed commit or deployment time.
The production request quantities and stock values were not included.
The pytest suite could not be executed because pytest is not installed in the investigation environment.
